cards.title: Commands of the administrator
items: scripts/aws-memory.sh deploy --stage dev --prepare, then --execute <change-set-name>, each with --profile and an owner word
scripts/aws-memory.sh outputs --stage dev --write saves .local/memory/dev.json (ignored by Git)
scripts/aws-memory.sh keys --stage dev --apply creates one key per user and gives it to the credential sync on standard input
scripts/aws-memory.sh client-config --stage dev --actor <a> prints the config: no AWS call, no key
Offboard: set status offboarded in config/memory/dev.yaml, remove the person from each project list, render, delete the keys of the user, then deploy
Rotate: scripts/aws-memory.sh rotate --stage dev --user <user> --apply, then delete the old key after the new key works

cards.title: Commands of the person
items: Pi: start pi with the AgentCore extension; the launch line sets AGENTCORE_MEMORY_CONFIG_FILE
Claude Code: claude --plugin-dir packages/agentcore-claude (a path in the tenant-pi kit)

AGENTCORE_PROJECT=

selects the project, because the client config of this design has no remotes or directories; without it, recall reads /shared/ and /actor// only and propose ends with project_none

Maintainer: the agentcore-memory CLI of the tenant-pi core, proposals list --project

--actor , then proposals approve or reject with --actor and --id
Files, an example: aws s3 cp <file> s3://<bucket>/users/<a>/ --profile tenant-ec2-memory-dev-person-<a>
Kill switch: Pi registers no hook and no tool; in Claude Code the hook prints nothing and each tool answers disabled

cards.title: Files that each side holds
items: Administrator: config/memory/dev.yaml, the generated scripts/aws-memory-dev.cfn.yaml, .local/memory/dev.json and the credential sync names TENANT_EC2_MEMORY_DEV_PERSON_<A>_KEY_ID and _SECRET
Person: ~/.aws/credentials (mode 0600) with the profile tenant-ec2-memory-dev-person-<a>
Person: ~/.config/agentcore-memory/config.json with schemaVersion, memoryId, region, profile, actorId and projects; it holds no key
Maintainer: the review ledger ~/.local/state/agentcore-memory/review-ledger.jsonl

cards.title: AWS calls and their scope
items:
Recall: RetrieveMemoryRecords on /shared/, /actor// and, with a project, /project/

/shared/

Propose: BatchCreateMemoryRecords into /project/

/proposals// only

Review: ListMemoryRecords on /project/

/proposals//, then BatchUpdateMemoryRecords from proposals to /project/

/shared/ or /project/

/rejected//

Files: s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject under users// and projects/

/; s3:DeleteObject under users// only
Every call carries the namespace condition key or an s3:prefix that the person policy and the stage boundary allow

cards.title: Refused requests, proven for dev
items: Writes: into project shared, into the own actor namespace, into the proposals of another person or project, and a batch with one refused namespace
Reads: another actor namespace, a project of which the person is no member, the proposals of another person, and the other memory of the account
Moves: a member, the proposer and the maintainer of another project
Deletes: no stage identity deletes a memory record
Files: the folder of another person, a project of which the person is no member, a delete in a project folder, a list with no prefix

cards.title: Proven and not verified
items: Proven for dev: the two-step deploy, one key per user, and the live access tests of the namespaces and prefixes on this page
Client config: the core parser of tenant-pi accepts the client-config output of the dev stage (validateConfig in packages/agentcore-memory-core/src/index.mjs, an offline check)
Not verified: the tenant-pi client against a stage of this design, the client-config and Send hand-over, the kill switch against such a stage, offboarding and key rotation
Not verified: a call with a deleted key on this design; the tenant-pi live proof shows that such a call fails
